description.en: LimeSurvey is the simple, quick and anonymous online survey tool that's bursting with juicy insights. Calling students, professionals and enterprises: design a survey and get the best insights, it’s free and as easy as squeezing a lime. Make a free online survey now!
description.it: LimeSurvey è uno strumento per sondaggi online semplice, rapido e anonimo.
